title: Among SME customers who made transactions at 'Discount' segment gas station
question: Among SME customers who made transactions at 'Discount' segment gas stations in the Czech Republic, which product had the highest total amount sold?

prediction.sql:
SELECT p.XCL_009
FROM customers c
INNER JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
INNER JOIN gasstations g ON t.XCL_015 = g.XCL_004
INNER JOIN products p ON t.XCL_016 = p.XCL_008
WHERE c.XCL_002 = 'SME'
  AND g.XCL_007 = 'Discount'
  AND g.XCL_006 = 'CZE'
GROUP BY p.XCL_009
ORDER BY SUM(t.XCL_018) DESC
LIMIT 1
